prompt: A professional film storyboard sheet: a clean grid of 6 panels in 2 rows of 3 columns (if fewer panels are listed, leave the extra slots plain light grey), thin white gutters, light grey background. Each panel has a large bold black number in its top-left corner: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. No other text, letters or numbers anywhere. HIGHLY CINEMATIC frames, like stills from a Tim Burton / Wes Anderson feature film: dramatic motivated lighting with a strong top key light and soft violet rim light, light haze in the air, deep shadows graded toward deep violet, glossy reflections on the floor, subtle film grain, anamorphic lens feel, very shallow depth of field, bold unusual camera angles (worm's-eye, extreme low angle, dutch angle, extreme macro). Set: lilac #A99BFF cube room, glossy near-black and cream checkerboard floor, one neon-lime yellow #EEFE3A square. NEUS's side of the board has nail polish bottles (lilac, deep violet, near-black, neon-lime); the opposite side has real glossy black chess pieces. Characters: NEUS = the woman from the reference images (identical face, long straight dark-brown hair with center part, sleek black leather suit, gold hoops, confident). THE DOUBLE = the exact same woman, same face and same straight hair slightly messy, beige oversized chunky knit sweater, unsure look. When both appear they are at OPPOSITE ends of the board. Correct anatomy and hands, photorealistic. Panel 3: low side-profile wide shot at floor level: both women at opposite ends lean over the board toward each other in the exact same mirrored pose, nose to nose in the middle, backlit haze between them. Panel 4: camera ON THE FLOOR, worm's-eye: huge out-of-focus polish bottles toppling toward the lens in the foreground; in the background THE DOUBLE towers, pushing a black knight, looking down into the lens. Panel 5: camera ON THE FLOOR: huge out-of-focus black pawns and a rook in the foreground; in the background NEUS lies on her stomach reaching toward the lens, fingertips just missing a rolling violet bottle. Panel 6: straight top-down bird's-eye view: NEUS lying on her side across the checkerboard like a chess piece, twelve squares glowing neon-lime with small floating gold coins, long dramatic shadows. Panel 7: extreme macro close-up of only NEUS's lips mid-word, violet rim light, film grain. Panel 8: Alice in Wonderland: the lilac cube has shrunk, NEUS crammed inside, back pressed against the ceiling, knees bent, wide-angle distortion, surprised expression.
